## Scope and files changed

List exact paths and explain why they changed.

## Scientific behavior and compatibility

Describe what changed, what was intentionally preserved, affected defaults or
interfaces, and downstream consumers. Write `No scientific behavior change`
when applicable.

## Validation

List exact commands, fixtures, representative runs, hashes, or CI checks and
their results.

## Not validated

List unavailable platform runs, runtime restores, datasets, or external
evidence. Do not leave this implicit.

## Required reviews and approvals

- [ ] Domain owner or independent scientific reviewer, when applicable
- [ ] Forge runtime review, when applicable
- [ ] Harbor deployment review, when applicable
- [ ] Beacon parity/provenance review, when applicable
- [ ] Explicit project-owner approval for a scientific default change,
      interface break, tag, publication, or release

## Versioning and provenance

Record the proposed module/interface/adapter version effect, canonical source
commit, runtime tag and digest when applicable, and any pending release facts.

## Risks and follow-up

State remaining decisions, downstream synchronization, platform validation,
or release work.
